title: Mariam Haling — 3rd IO Review summary (2026-06-12)
text:
If you require any further information, please contact the Council’s Hearings Manager at Level 29,
One Canada Square, London, E14 5AA or, by telephone, on 020 7436 3898
BEFORE THE FITNESS TO PRACTISE COMMITTEE
OF THE GENERAL OPTICAL COUNCIL
IO(25)02

___________________________________________________________________

THIRD INTERIM ORDER REVIEW
DETERMINATION SUMMARY
12 June 2026
___________________________________________________________________

PRIVATE HEARING

Name of Registrant: Mariam Haling
Registration number: SO-14896
Professional status: Student Optometrist
Type and length of interim order: The Fitness to Practise Committee determined
to make an interim order of suspension from 10 February 2025 for a period of 18
months.

On 21 July 2025, 05 January 2026 and 12 June 2026, the Fitness to Practise
Committee determined to maintain the current interim order of suspension.

The Committee notes that the order is due to expire on 10 August 2026 and
therefore makes no order for a further review. However, if the order is extended by
the Courts, a review will be held within 3 months of the date of the extension.
court: General Optical Council — Fitness to Practise Committee
